studies.title: The outrigger canoe
studies.caption: Austronesian boatbuilders lash a float to a dugout hull on outrigger booms, making a narrow canoe stable in open water.
studies.prompt: Water-level side view beside an Austronesian dugout canoe in Island Southeast Asia about1200BCE; one slender stabilizing float connected to the main hull by two bent wooden booms with fiber lashings clearly visible. A paddler crosses a small channel; forested islands beyond. No modern hardware.
